social.author: Madam Comfort
social.text: One young man chased okada thief through go-slow and brought back my bag. {player} God bless you!!

social.author: Owambe Police
social.text: BREAKING: Designer aso-ebi at last night's party was from Balo Market. We have receipts. Literally.

social.author: Lagos Traffic Gist
social.text: Who was racing on Third Lagoon Bridge at 1am?? Somebody's Kamsi flew past like it owed money.

social.author: Oshoja Updates
social.text: Shina Garage's boys searching every bus park. Whoever they're looking for is long gone.

social.author: Mile One Massive
social.text: Flood carried half the market but one guy in a pickup saved the fish. Hero of the rains.

social.author: Creek Watch
social.text: Speedboat chase in the mangroves today. Marine Patrol 'regrets to inform' they lost him.

social.author: Deltacrest Petroleum (Official)
social.text: Yesterday's incident was a routine drill. All workers are safe thanks to our world-class safety culture.

social.author: Capital Society
social.text: Big Bar's transparency gala was SO transparent someone photographed the donor list. Iconic.

social.author: Abuja Roads
social.text: 17-car convoy reduced to 16-car convoy on the expressway. Investigations ongoing. Nobody saw anything.

social.author: Zainab Yusuf-Cole
social.text: LIVE NOW: The Big Bar files. Three cities, one ledger. Thank you to a source who wants to stay anonymous (you know yourself).

social.author: Checkpoint Chronicles
social.text: Another day, another 'happy weekend' on camera. Driver of the Kamsi, we see you. #CheckpointChronicles

social.author: Mr. Logic
social.text: If you 'settle' at a checkpoint, you are not settling anything. You are unsettling everything. Caller, go ahead.

social.author: Integrity Unit (Parody)
social.text: Our undercover officer accepted ₦10,000 'for weekend'. The giver is now trending AND wanted.

social.author: Road Warrior
social.text: Passed 4 checkpoints today. Each one had a different idea of what 'particulars' means.

social.author: Road Warrior
social.text: Spent 40 minutes at a checkpoint explaining that a spare tyre is not contraband.

social.author: Garden City Vibes
social.text: New face in Mile Three. Lagos accent, Lagos hustle. Let's see if he can handle the creeks.

social.author: Protocol AM
social.text: Sources say a 'Lagos boy with Port Harcourt connections' just landed in the capital. Big men, lock your files.
